title: openai-compat: tool_choice semantics + schema mapping + message formatting
author: Ava Liu
description: Motivation: improve Redwood's OpenAI compatibility layer for function/tool calling by aligning tool_choice semantics, adding robust tool schema mapping, and normalizing tool invocation message formatting. This PR resolves compatibility gaps surfaced by partner integrations and reduces ambiguity when multiple tools match a model's tool selection output. Changes are backwards-compatible by default and gated behind the openai_compat.v2 feature flag for canary rollout. Summary of changes: 1) Implement tool_choice semantics: when the LLM returns a tool identifier plus confidence/score fields, the compatibility layer now honors explicit tool_choice hints, resolves ties deterministically, and exposes a normalized decision in the response envelope. 2) Tool schema mapping: introduce a schema_mapper that maps OpenAI-style tool JSON schemas to Redwood's internal tool descriptor (name, params schema, required/optional) including support for oneOf/allOf simplifications and automatic default value injection. 3) Tool message formatting: normalize messages emitted to tools (role, name, content) to match both OpenAI and Redwood service expectations, including strict trimming of leading/trailing whitespace, consistent JSON serialization for structured params, and preservation of tool call metadata (original_prompt_tokens, chosen_tool_confidence). 4) Tests and docs: comprehensive unit and integration tests that simulate multiple model outputs (tool id only, tool id + args, tool_choice array, ambiguous matches) plus updated docs and migration notes. Rollout: feature gated behind openai_compat.v2; default disabled for existing clients. We will enable for internal canary accounts and a small set of partners for one week before full rollout. Backwards compatibility: default behavior remains the existing simple mapping when v2 flag is off. When on, some edge cases where models returned ambiguous tool IDs will see deterministic selection instead of first-match behavior; callers who relied on first-match must update to the explicit tool_choice contract. Monitoring: added telemetry for tool_choice rate, tie-breaker occurrences, and schema mapping failures with automatic fallback to legacy mapping. Testing: unit tests added for schema_mapper, end-to-end harness tests simulating streaming tool outputs, and fuzz tests for malformed tool args. See commits and files changed for details.

review_comments: Diego Morales: Overall this looks good; left a couple of nit comments on deterministic ordering and an edge case for identical confidence scores.
Ava Liu (author): replied: added tie-breaker by lexicographic tool id after sorting by confidence; updated tests to cover identical confidence scenario.
Priya Nair: Please add an explicit telemetry event for schema mapping fallback with a sample rate. Also ensure we cap the size of serialized params to avoid OOM from malicious model outputs.
Ava Liu (author): replied: added telemetry event openai_compat.schema_mapping.fallback and size cap at 64KB with defensive truncation; tests updated.
Sam Carter: CI flaked once on the integration harness; was the timeout margin increased?
Ava Liu (author): replied: yes, increased harness timeout to 30s; flagged flaky network dependency and added retry logic in test harness.
Priya Nair: APPROVED after telemetry and cap changes.
release_notes: OpenAI compatibility: v2 tool-calling semantics (feature-gated). Adds deterministic tool_choice resolution, improved schema mapping, and normalized tool message formatting. Backwards-compatible by default; see docs for migration steps.
notes_for_release: Enabled behind openai_compat.v2 feature flag. Enable for internal canary first and monitor openai_compat.schema_mapping.fallback metric. Migration: callers relying on first-match tool selection should validate tool_choice semantics when flipping the flag.
testing_summary: Added 24 new unit tests, 6 integration scenarios in the harness, and fuzz tests for malformed tool arguments. CI: all checks passed after one retry on intermittent integration timeout.
manual_steps: N/A - feature gated. To enable for an account: set feature flag openai_compat.v2=true in account config and restart compatibility workers if running private deployment.
safety_considerations: Cap serialized params to 64KB to prevent OOM. Malformed JSON in model outputs will trigger schema mapping fallback and be surfaced in telemetry; we do not execute tool calls with invalid params.
changelog_entry: openai-compat: implement v2 tool calling semantics (tool_choice, schema mapping, message formatting) - feature gated
notes: Follow-up work tracked in ENG-2539 to extend schema mapping to oneOf composed tooling and to add a migration utility for partners that expect legacy first-match behavior.
